sections.title: Interview Answer
Mental Model
sections.content:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    H[handler: request context] --> S[service: order operation]
    S --> D[DB: user ID, table]
    S --> A[API: orderID, endpoint]
    S --> Q[queue: orderID, topic]
    D -->|w: %w| H
    A -->|w: %w| H
    Q -->|log + outbox| S
    H --> CHAIN[caller sees: process order 123: charge: connection refused]
```

sections.title: Deep Dive
sections.content:
The wrap decision per layer, formalized:
- The DB layer knows WHAT it queried (the WHERE, the table, the ID)
- The service layer knows WHAT operation (charge order, process payment)
- The handler knows the HTTP context (the route, the request)
- Each adds its fact via %w; none re-wraps blindly

The action matrix (where errors get HANDLED, not just wrapped):
- Connection refused (DB/API): retry with backoff (the caller or middleware)
- Not found (DB): the caller's domain logic (404, empty result, skip)
- Card declined: terminal — no retry, user-facing
- Queue publish: outbox/local retry — the operation's success doesn't depend on the notification

The error-as-value design payoff: every branch above is a return + a wrap — the code reads linearly, each decision visible. No catch blocks separating the handling from the operation.
